<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.SaintGeo: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

A 1D hydraulic model of a river, based on the equations of de Saint-Venant: water levels and discharges along its sections, in time, for a discharge entering at its head.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** 1D, Hydraulic<br>
**Authors:** Silvia Franceschi, Andrea Antonello, Riccardo Rigon, Angelo Zacchia<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.SaintGeo`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRiverPoints` | vector file |  |  | The points of the river between the sections, from RiverSectionsExtractor. |
| `inSections` | vector file |  |  | The section lines, from RiverSectionsExtractor. |
| `inSectionPoints` | vector file |  |  | The points of the sections, with their elevation, from RiverSectionsExtractor. |
| `inDischarge` | CSV file |  |  | The discharge entering at the head of the river, with a value for each step of the model. |
| `inDownstreamLevel` | CSV file |  |  | The water level at the last section, with a value for each step. If not given, the flow passes through the critical depth. |
| `inLateralId2Discharge` | CSV file |  |  | The lateral inflows (positive) or outflows (negative), for the ids of the sections, with a value for each step. |
| `inConfluenceId2Discharge` | CSV file |  |  | The inflows from confluences, for the ids of the sections, with a value for each step. |
| `pKs` | Double |  |  | The Gauckler-Strickler coefficient of the sections that have none. |
| `pDeltaTMillis` | long | millisec | `5000` | Not used: the model sets the length of its steps, for the stability of the scheme. |
| `outTableName` | String |  | `saintgeoresults` | Name of the output results table in the geopackage (data are overwritten at each run). |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outGpkg` | output file |  | The output GeoPackage, with a row for each step and section: its timestep, sectionid, progressivedistance, waterlevel, discharge, celerity (the mean velocity), froudenumber, wettedarea, minsectionelevation, leftbankelevation and rightbankelevation. |
